views.caveat: Logistic regression on 470 patients, 27 with MSI_TYPE = Instable (1 term). Every other observed value of MSI_TYPE (Do not report, Indeterminate, Stable) was treated as “not event.” 1 patient from patient-level participants lacked the outcome or a covariate and were excluded. Computed from real per-patient rows within each local study — not pooled aggregate counts across untrusted remote peers.

steps.title: Fetch one row per patient
steps.detail: The logisticRows query above. Patients with a value for MSI_TYPE and for every covariate are kept. 1 cohort patient had no row.

steps.title: Code the outcome
steps.detail: 1 if MSI_TYPE = “Instable”, else 0 — every other observed value (Do not report, Indeterminate, Stable) counts as not the event.

steps.title: Code the covariates
steps.detail: Each numeric covariate is one term. Each categorical covariate becomes one 0/1 term per level, measured against a reference level that gets no term.
params: 1 if c0 = “Mutated”, else 0 · 325 of 470 patients · reference “Not mutated”: the fixed default for a mutated-vs-not axis

steps.title: Fit a logistic regression
steps.detail: Maximum likelihood for a binomial GLM with a logit link and an intercept, by Newton–Raphson with step-halving.
params: from the Fisher information at the estimate

method.verification: Matches statsmodels 0.15.0 Logit to a relative 1e-6 on coefficients, SEs, p-values and intervals (test/regression-golden.test.ts).
